# Public personal-data redaction rule — 19 September 2026

**Control:** PD-PRIVACY-REDACTION-20260919  
**Scope:** every public Project Sun Rock / Por Derecho page, image, PDF derivative, screenshot, social-media asset and repository-publication package.

## Standing rule

Before public release of any receipt, filing, screenshot, scan, PDF or image derivative, redact unnecessary personal information. In particular:

- never publish a private residential, home, street or postal address;
- redact NIE/NIF/passport/identity-document numbers unless the identifier is strictly necessary to the public evidential point and separately authorised;
- redact private/personal email addresses and telephone numbers unless publication is strictly necessary and expressly authorised;
- redact signatures, verification codes, QR/security tokens and other authentication material unless a controlled public derivative specifically requires them;
- preserve the unredacted original only in private evidence custody;
- mark the public derivative as redacted where that fact is material;
- preserve public-safe registry number, date, recipient, subject, attachment name and integrity/hash metadata where useful to traceability.

A public receipt or screenshot must be reviewed at image level as well as text level. Cropping, compression or conversion never counts as redaction.

This rule is additive to the repository public/private boundary. It does not require removal of already-public institutional or business addresses that are themselves the evidential subject; it protects private personal contact/location information.

## Current-thread application

The 24-August-2026 RedSARA receipts contain private applicant data and are not to be republished unredacted. The RICPE / Sun Park / CNMV LinkedIn landing page uses public-safe metadata and source-controlled institutional facts only; no home address, identity number, private email or private phone is shown.
